note: 原站 / the source site (SDSZ College Fair). 规范出口：只在使用者明说要原站外观时才对它求相似度以外的用途。similarity.py 以 axes 里的 12 个键为准（flat 或 nested 都可读）；其余字段给人和 grep 用。/ similarity.py reads only the 12 keys under `axes`; everything else is for humans and greps.

axes_read_as.palette_family: BUILD-SPEC §5: `<palette.structure>|a<bucket>|b<bucket>`, hue bucket = int(OKLCH h // 30) * 30 of the light-scheme --a / --b ('n' when chroma < 0.03). a = navy #13294B (h 258.9 -> 240), b = red #C8102E (h 22.3 -> 0).
axes_read_as.ground: light | dark — the native page ground.
axes_read_as.display_class: the `class` of the display font in the direction library (Zilla Slab = slab-serif). Must equal library/directions.json varsity.type.display[0].class; if the library spells it differently, change both together.
axes_read_as.label_style: `<label_case>|<stretch class>|<mono|prop>` — uppercase, Archivo pinned at width 125 = wide, proportional.
axes_read_as.numerals: outlined = the signature chamfered three-layer numerals (logo and room numbers); data figures are lining-tabular as a secondary rule, not the fingerprint value.
axes_read_as.motion_bucket: kit.motion_bucket(dur, bounce): still = bounce <= 0.04 and dur >= 0.45; lively = bounce >= 0.18; firm = between. Source UI springs: dur 0.30-0.35, bounce 0 -> firm (camera 0.45-0.55 is only used inside the map).

source_values_not_used_in_kit.why: climb-light is only 26.7 deg from --b in OKLCH (kit floor: >= 50); dark focus ring is 2.86:1 on #0D1D36 (floor: >= 3)

label.name: Archivo Expanded
label.note: Archivo variable, width axis pinned at 125

type.cjk: 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
type.cjk_display: same as cjk (sans); serif 'Songti SC', 'STSong', 'Noto Serif SC' only for report chapter titles and quotes
type.scale: hand-tuned, not a ratio: .74 / 1 / 1.12 / 1.65 rem, then clamp(2.5rem,7.6vw,4.7rem) and clamp(3.6rem,19vw,9rem)

tells.note: 命中其中三类以上，而使用者没要原站外观，就是在复制原站。/ three or more categories hit, with no request for the source look = copying the source.

signature: warm chalk page #F7F5F0, never white; navy headings, ink body, one red for where / now / act
slab-serif entity name set huge (line-height .86, tracking -.025em) over a 6px rule with a 64px accent tip
uppercase wide label (.2em) followed by a small muted second-language gloss on the same baseline
8px chamfered flat buttons in three fills; chamfer only on interactive things; the only circle is the crest
navy-chalk-red-chalk-navy 3:1:2:1:3 stripe as divider, footer cap and photo stand-in
2px navy top rule + 1px stone row rules (door-sign lists); crest cell grid 2/3/4 columns, no cards
full-bleed red room band with outlined room numeral and booth number on a 3px underline
translucent 56px bar that melts into the page; 2px hairline with a 96px red tip appears on scroll
navy welcome panel with logo; on phones a 112px navy strip, then a two-line hand-broken headline
red solid numerals 03 / 10 / 52 with tiny wide-caps captions
dark mode = deep navy #0D1D36 (not black), red lightened to #FF7084 for text only
inset floating bottom sheet with a 6px red cap on a critically damped spring
orbit canvas map: hollow white rooms + navy-capped 1m walls on paper-coloured floor, crest badges on 2.1m pins
route line = chalk halo + red + marching white dashes; stairs in amber
